GRADE 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 32 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Panch- mahabhoot at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. state water bodies that are considered sacred as mentioned in the Scriptures to strengthen faith,
   B. Learners should ignore Panch- mahabhoot completely.
   C. Panch- mahabhoot is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Panch- mahabhoot.

2. About Panch- mahabhoot at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the role of water in our daily lives,
   B. Learners should ignore Panch- mahabhoot completely.
   C. Panch- mahabhoot is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Panch- mahabhoot.

3. About Panch- mahabhoot when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. appreciate the importance of jal (water) used for religious activities in different faiths for its sacredness.
   B. Learners should ignore Panch- mahabhoot completely.
   C. Panch- mahabhoot is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Panch- mahabhoot.

5. About Dainik Prarthana at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the three selected prayers performed for different occasions for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Dainik Prarthana completely.
   C. Dainik Prarthana is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Dainik Prarthana.

6. About Dainik Prarthana at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recite the three selected prayers for understanding the meanings to deepen the faith,
   B. Learners should ignore Dainik Prarthana completely.
   C. Dainik Prarthana is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Dainik Prarthana.

7. About Dainik Prarthana when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. appreciate the importance of prayers in daily life for spiritual development,
   B. Learners should ignore Dainik Prarthana completely.
   C. Dainik Prarthana is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Dainik Prarthana.

9. About Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o completely.
   C. Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o.

10. About Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o completely.
   C. Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o.

11. About Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o completely.
   C. Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o.

13. About Aspects of integrity at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Aspects of integrity using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of integrity completely.
   C. Aspects of integrity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of integrity.

14. About Aspects of integrity at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Aspects of integrity at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of integrity completely.
   C. Aspects of integrity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of integrity.

15. About Aspects of integrity when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Aspects of integrity helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of integrity completely.
   C. Aspects of integrity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of integrity.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Panch- mahabhoot at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Dainik Prarthana at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Aspects of integrity at home with your family.
